# AERIS MUSIC

> Public status: the paid music catalog is temporarily closed while audio quality, licensing, and payment-to-delivery are re-verified.

## Available now
- [Free CC0 music catalog](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/free/): the page currently lists 13 downloadable tracks under its stated CC0 terms.
- [Support](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/support.html): support options; payout completion is not represented as verified here.

## Paid catalog
- Status: CLOSED.
- Paid track catalog API: [catalog.json](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/agents/catalog.json) currently returns an empty catalog.
- Creator kits and legacy paid landing pages are not being advertised while the payment-to-delivery path is checked.
- Existing Stripe links may still exist in the payment provider; removal from this website does not itself deactivate those links.
- Verified revenue: $0.00 as of the latest status record. Checkout links, clicks, points, or API handshakes are not revenue.

## Agent endpoint
- [AERIS x402 Worker health](https://aeris-x402.farmmer-938.workers.dev/health)
- [AERIS x402 Worker OpenAPI](https://aeris-x402.farmmer-938.workers.dev/openapi.json)
- The Worker is a separate metered endpoint. Its live handshake is not evidence of a completed paid sale or a track-license purchase.

## Release rule
A product may return to paid sale only after technical audio QA, listening review, originality/licensing review, buyer-use-case validation, market-demand evidence, live checkout verification, and successful end-to-end delivery are all evidenced.
